annotation.title_clean: AI for the Good of All: Brazilian Artificial Intelligence Plan
annotation.title_en: AI for the Good of All: Brazilian Artificial Intelligence Plan
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation (MCTI); Center for Strategic Studies and Management (CGEE)
annotation.summary_en: Brazil's national AI plan (PBIA), issued by MCTI and CGEE under the National Council for Science and Technology. It aims at sovereign, sustainable and socially inclusive AI. It sets out immediate-impact actions and five structuring axes: infrastructure, training, public services, business innovation, and support for AI regulation and governance. It also covers investment and monitoring.
key_provisions_or_claims: Five structuring axes: infrastructure and AI development; diffusion, training and qualification; AI for public services; AI for business innovation; support for regulatory and governance processes
Immediate impact actions applying AI in sectors such as health, agriculture, education and public administration
Large public investment in AI infrastructure, including supercomputing and national capabilities, to strengthen technological sovereignty
AI literacy, training and reskilling programmes from basic education to postgraduate level
Governance and monitoring structure for the plan, coordinated by MCTI and the CCT
